offering_voiceAiCallcenter.name: Voice AI for call centers
offering_voiceAiCallcenter.tagline: Phone bots with STT, TTS and intelligent routing
offering_voiceAiCallcenter.description: Custom build or monthly SaaS subscription of "Voice AI for call centers". Buy it as software (we hand over the code) or pay monthly while we host it for you.

basico.name: Basic
basico.description: To validate the idea with a limited scope
basico.idealPara: Small teams getting started with conversation minutes
incluye: Email support Mon–Fri 8AM–5PM Colombia, 24h business response

profesional.name: Professional
profesional.idealPara: SMBs with steady flow and conversation minutes

avanzado.name: Advanced
avanzado.description: Multi-channel with high volume and personalization
avanzado.idealPara: Mid-market companies with high volumes of conversation minutes
incluye: Email + WhatsApp + Slack Connect support, 2h business response

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.idealPara: Enterprises with compliance and thousands of conversation minutes
incluye: Jira/Zendesk tickets with audit, 1h critical / 4h high / 24h medium

offering_voiceAiCallcenter.costoNote: Twilio + Deepgram + ElevenLabs (~$300–$50,000 USD/mo) are paid by the customer directly to the provider.
